title: sms_since input
description: The input of the phone's sms_since tool, as tools/list gives it (ADR-CVM-010). Passing a cursor acknowledges every message in the answer that gave it, and the dropped count that answer carried: only then does the phone delete them.

cursor.description: The cursor from the last answer, passed back exactly as it came. It is opaque: the bridge never reads it, compares it or builds one. Left out, or null, at the bridge's first call: the answer then starts at the oldest message the phone still keeps.
